summary: SS Innovations International, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing under Item 8.01 a press release updating continuing progress and milestones. The release highlights global expansion, pediatric robotic surgery, telesurgery, and growing SSi Mantra installations, procedures, and utilization, including a July 29, 2026 robotic cardiac program launch in Colombia and an August 23, 2026 procedure in Sri Lanka. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are stated. This is a routine business update, not a special situation. What to watch: commercial adoption metrics and regulatory clearances, not arbitrage.
